name: Shiina Alice
source:
Alice is a student with a cold personality that can do anything fairly well, although don't really get interested in anything.
She thinks of herself as an ordinary school girl, but has an unapproachable atmosphere because of her sharp eyes.
Seems like a hard to please person and that's why doesn't have many friends. 

"It's my responsibility so I will take care of it"

Thus, it was decided that she will be taking care of the dog called Hechima. Slowly, Alice falls in love with a dog...

Her chest is around C cup.
